set(UI_SRC_DIRS
  "."
  "fonts"
)

set(UI_INCLUDE_DIRS
  "."
  "fonts"
)

set(UI_REQUIRES
  lvgl
)

idf_component_register(
  SRC_DIRS ${UI_SRC_DIRS}
  INCLUDE_DIRS ${UI_INCLUDE_DIRS}
  REQUIRES ${UI_REQUIRES}
)

# Auto-include app action declarations into UI source files generated by SquareLine/EEZ
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
  "-include${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/main/actions/app_actions.h"
  # "-include${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/main/actions/other_actions.h"
)
